verdict.rationale: BVNK documents funding in stablecoins and paying out in fiat [bvnk-docs-18, bvnk-docs-19, bvnk-docs-9]. Its fiat payout docs cover both first-party and third-party bank-account payouts from virtual accounts [bvnk-docs-11, bvnk-docs-24], with USD/EUR/GBP virtual accounts and a 130+ country footprint claimed [bvnk-docs-12, bvnk-docs-27]. The stablecoin-to-bank flow has to be pieced together from marketing copy and payout pages rather than a dedicated off-ramp guide. Missing for 10: a dedicated stablecoin-to-bank off-ramp guide, a published per-country/per-currency payout rail list (e.g. SEPA/ACH/Faster Payments coverage), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
